name: Van pack
summary: A two-minute packing game for move-out day: the back of a moving van as a grid, everyone gets the same stuff in the same order; slide each thing over a column, turn it, drop it and it falls in, what doesn't fit stays on the curb, and whoever fills the most space drives.
useWhen: 'we're never fitting all this in one trip'
who's driving the moving van lol
a quick game while packing up the apartment
moving day and everyone's arguing about how to pack the truck
dontUseWhen: planning who drives which car (use carpool)
checking if a couch fits up the stairs (use stairwell-pivot)
splitting the shared stuff when a lease ends (use lease-divvy)

move.description: Whose move, short, e.g. '412 Pine move-out · one trip'

stuff.description: 4 to 12 things in the order they come out: name and shape (box 1 cell, bigbox 2x2, couch 3 long, mattress 3 tall, lamp 2 tall, tv 2 wide, desk L of 4, chair L of 3); the van holds 35 cells

runs.description: Earlier runs: who, cells filled (0 to 35, at most the stuff's total size), and a short line
